exposure: Time taken from decision to delivery to delivery of anesthesia
cohort: Parturients undergoing emergency caesarean section at South Gondar Zone Hospitals, Northwest Ethiopia
finding: The study found that only 17.5% of parturients achieved a decision-to-delivery interval ≤30 minutes, with a median interval of 54 minutes, and while this prolonged interval was not directly correlated with significant fetal adverse outcomes, it remains a concern.
